name: Compute Cluster S69: Clustering & Anomaly Detection
description: Tests: kmeans(num_clusters, window_size, step), dbscan(epsilon, min_points, window_size, step), pca(n_components, window_size, step). Rolling ML clustering with tuple_pack features.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S69: Clustering & Anomaly Detection
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === FEATURES ===
feat_ret = returns(period=21)(close)
feat_vol = volatility(period=21)(close)
features = (feat_ret, feat_vol)

# === K-MEANS CLUSTERING ===
km = kmeans(num_clusters=3, window_size=252, step=63)(features)
cluster = km.cluster_label

# === DBSCAN ANOMALY DETECTION ===
db = dbscan(epsilon=0.5, min_points=5, window_size=252, step=63)(features)
is_anomaly = db.is_anomaly
db_label = db.cluster_label

# === PCA FACTOR EXTRACTION ===
pc = pca(n_components=2, window_size=252, step=63)(features)
expl_var = pc.explained_variance_ratio

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='K-Means Cluster Label (3 regimes)',
    category='Clustering',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cluster', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cluster)

xy_lines(
    title='PCA Explained Variance Ratio',
    category='PCA',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Var Explained', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=expl_var)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='DBSCAN Anomaly'
    )
)(feat_ret, feat_vol, is_anomaly)
